arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal fastest finish. 1) Let the start settle; target shaft power near sustainable_shaft_power (~185 W pod) and even effort; reserve to be spent in the last ~800 m (finish cue ~600-700 m to go). 2) Min 3-12: check CP with heart rate (at steady effort near CP, HR should level; still climbing = CP too high). Use measure() on steady legs. 3) Set watches for: pod reserve low, speed loss vs pod power (weed: clear_rudder; pod drift: compare with HR and boat power), HR runaway. 4) Radio messages may change course length: set_race_distance + tell. 5) Save cues (20 max).

arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (odd legs out/north, even back/south). POD IS DRIFTING HIGH from race_s ~580: ignore pod power, pod reserve, push_local. Boat-model power/reserve also unreliable while the wind change (from the south, radio race_s 625) settles. Pace by HR (sustainable ~164, flat) and GPS pace. Plan: hold ~155 s/500 over the ground (pace target makes them work a bit more into the headwind legs); if HR climbs >1 bpm/min for 2+ min, ease. Finish sprint cue at ~700 m to go (about 3 min hard). Watch for weed (GPS drop with HR flat: clear_rudder) and radio course changes (set_race_distance + tell). Save cues.
